title: Claude Code cloud session tools (claude-code-remote MCP server), as seen in this session
url: the tool definitions this cloud session was given on 2026-11-01
summary: Seen first hand, not in the docs read: this cloud session has an MCP server, claude-code-remote, whose tools create_session (a new cloud session with a prompt, repository and branch), send_message (a message into another session), list_sessions, get_session (title, status and a status_bucket: working, blocked, review_ready, completed or failed), list_events (the transcript: user and assistant messages, tool calls, results), archive_session, interrupt_session, set_session_tags, create_trigger and send_later. avenMAIA starts AIP threads with them today. Whether the same server is reachable from a local session on Samuel's Mac was not checked.
ideas: Every piece D-43 needs for a thread exists as a tool: create one per intent, message it, read its transcript and its state.
status_bucket 'blocked' is the signal for 'waiting on Samuel'.
Tags can mark a session with its intent (aip:AIP-4).
